composition_claim.text: Every good pair either has some interval j with (I j).1 = (I j).2 — putting it in SinglePairs — or satisfies (I j).1 < (I j).2 for all j — putting it in ProperPairs. So {I | IsGood I} ⊆ SinglePairs ∪ ProperPairs, and since both are finite by children 2 and 3 (child 1 supplying the parity classification behind child 2), Set.Finite.union and Set.Finite.subset yield the parent.
